exact.日本學者福島邦彥（Kunihiko Fukushima）於 1980 年提出 n: The Japanese researcher Kunihiko Fukushima proposed the neocognitron in 1980, introducing hierarchical receptive fields; Yann LeCun adapted it for handwritten digit recognition around 1989 and established LeNet in 1998.
exact.1998 年 LeCun 等人發表 LeNet-5 論文時，同時引入了 MNIS: When LeCun et al. published the LeNet-5 paper in 1998, they also introduced MNIST (Modified NIST) as a standard benchmark dataset, with 60,000 training images and 10,000 test images.
exact.經典順序：輸入後初次卷積得 $28\\times 28\\times 6$，池化: The classic order: after the input, the first convolution gives $28\times 28\times 6$, pooling halves it to $14\times 14$, the second convolution gives $10\times 10\times 16$, the second pooling gives $5\times 5$, and finally it is flattened into a vector and fed to FC 120-84-10.
exact.「先局部空間抽特徵、後全域全連線做分類」的兩段式管線，成為隨後 AlexNet、: The two-stage pipeline of "first extract local spatial features, then classify with global fully connected layers" became the golden design prototype for decades of standard CNNs that followed, such as AlexNet and VGG.
exact.輸入手寫數字灰階影像 (MNIST)。單通道，每個畫素為 0~1 的灰階值。: The input is a grayscale handwritten-digit image (MNIST). Single channel; each pixel is a gray value from 0 to 1.
exact.6 個 5×5 卷積核 (padding=2)，權重數：5×5×1×6 + 6(: 6 kernels of size 5×5 (padding=2); number of weights: 5×5×1×6 + 6(bias) = 156. Captures basic horizontal/vertical/diagonal edges.
exact.2×2 平均池化 (stride=2)。尺寸砍半，通道不變。大幅壓縮空間維度。: 2×2 average pooling (stride=2). Halves the size and keeps the channels. Greatly compresses the spatial dimensions.
exact.16 個 5×5 卷積核 (no padding)。特徵圖縮至 10×10。組合: 16 kernels of size 5×5 (no padding). The feature maps shrink to 10×10. Combines local edges into strokes and corners.
exact.2×2 平均池化 (stride=2)。尺寸縮至 5×5。每個特徵圖只剩 25: 2×2 average pooling (stride=2). The size shrinks to 5×5. Each feature map has only 25 units left, 400 feature values in total.
exact.展平 400 維向量後的全連線隱藏層。權重數：400×120 + 120 = 4: A fully connected hidden layer after flattening into a 400-dimensional vector. Number of weights: 400×120 + 120 = 48,120 (most of the whole network's parameters!).
exact.全連線隱藏層。權重數：120×84 + 84 = 10,164。進一步壓縮語意表: A fully connected hidden layer. Number of weights: 120×84 + 84 = 10,164. Further compresses the semantic representation.
exact.10 類別輸出（數字 0 到 9）。權重數：84×10 + 10 = 850。輸: 10-class output (digits 0 to 9). Number of weights: 84×10 + 10 = 850. Outputs the predicted probability of each class.
exact.全網路總參數量：: Total parameters of the whole network:

fbb17ec1fcdc.en: The Prototype of the Modern CNN

b0ae2881a676.zh: LeNet 與典型 CNN 骨架 LeNet and the Classic CNN Skeleton
b0ae2881a676.en: LeNet and the Typical CNN Skeleton

21a1c10e2f12.zh: 從福島邦彥 1980 年 neocognitron 到 LeCun 1998 年 LeNet，奠定了現代卷積神經網路的黃金原型：「前面卷積＋池化抽局部特徵，結尾全連線做全域決策」。尺寸口訣 $28\times 28\times 6 \to 14\times 14 \to 10\times 10\times 16 \to 5\times 5 \to 120\text{-}84\text{-}10$。
21a1c10e2f12.en: From Kunihiko Fukushima's 1980 neocognitron to LeCun's 1998 LeNet, the golden prototype of the modern convolutional neural network was laid down: "convolution + pooling up front to extract local features, fully connected layers at the end for the global decision." The size mnemonic: $28\times 28\times 6 \to 14\times 14 \to 10\times 10\times 16 \to 5\times 5 \to 120\text{-}84\text{-}10$.

8a6c0c2d4ec9.zh:
「LeNet 骨架：先掃空間，最後才決策？」 在空間資訊消失之前把特徵抽好；全連線不是主角，出現得愈晚愈好！
Local scanning first, global classification last — the CNN blueprint born in 1998.
8a6c0c2d4ec9.en: "The LeNet skeleton: scan space first, decide only at the end?" Extract the features well before the spatial information disappears; the fully connected layers are not the stars, and the later they show up, the better!

503dd1cb5e44.zh: 從 Neocognitron 到 LeNet：手寫數字的標準答案 From Neocognitron to LeNet: Setting the Standard for Digit Recognition
503dd1cb5e44.en: From the Neocognitron to LeNet: the Standard Answer for Handwritten Digits

b34ac32eaa8c.zh: 深度學習不是 2012 年才突然出現的
b34ac32eaa8c.en: Deep learning did not suddenly appear in 2012

23544bcff172.zh: 早在 1980 年，日本學者福島邦彥（Kunihiko Fukushima）便提出了 neocognitron，模仿生物視覺皮層 S-cell（簡單細胞，負責抓局部方向）與 C-cell（複雜細胞，容許局部平移），具備了「分層抽取、局部感受野」的架構雛型。
23544bcff172.en: As early as 1980, the Japanese researcher Kunihiko Fukushima proposed the neocognitron, which mimicked the S-cells (simple cells, which pick up local orientations) and C-cells (complex cells, which tolerate local shifts) of the biological visual cortex, and already had the rudiments of an architecture with "layered extraction and local receptive fields."

25332992e275.zh: 引入分層過濾與局部感受野概念，為卷積與池化結構埋下理論種子。
25332992e275.en: Introduces layered filtering and local receptive fields, planting the theoretical seed for convolution and pooling structures.

8403c045beac.zh: Yann LeCun 團隊首度將反向傳播應用於卷積網路
8403c045beac.en: Yann LeCun's team applies backpropagation to convolutional networks for the first time

8cf619571aa8.zh: 發表手寫郵遞區號辨識系統，直接以反向傳播梯度端到端訓練濾波器權重。
8cf619571aa8.en: Publishes a handwritten ZIP-code recognition system that trains the filter weights end-to-end directly with backpropagated gradients.

0c543bc0987c.zh: LeNet-5 發表與 MNIST 基準集問世
0c543bc0987c.en: LeNet-5 is published and the MNIST benchmark appears

e759e88fc96e.zh: LeCun、Bottou、Bengio 與 Haffner 正式確立 LeNet-5 架構，同時推出著名的 MNIST（Modified NIST） 28×28 手寫數字基準集。
e759e88fc96e.en: LeCun, Bottou, Bengio and Haffner formally establish the LeNet-5 architecture and at the same time release the famous MNIST (Modified NIST) benchmark of 28×28 handwritten digits.

be28916e5a32.zh: LeNet 經典流水線：五步尺寸演變口訣 The LeNet Pipeline: Five-Stage Dimension Transition
be28916e5a32.en: The Classic LeNet Pipeline: a Five-Step Size Mnemonic

3da49e1fde59.zh: 課本 Fig. 1 呈現了一條清晰的「特徵抽取 $\to$ 分類決策」流水線。空間尺寸隨著交替的卷積與池化逐漸縮小，通道數則相應增加：
3da49e1fde59.en: The textbook's Fig. 1 shows a clear "feature extraction $\to$ classification decision" pipeline. The spatial size shrinks step by step through alternating convolution and pooling, while the number of channels grows correspondingly:

4bae5592d48d.zh: 輸入灰階影像經過 6 組 5×5 核卷積，萃取 6 種低階幾何特徵。
4bae5592d48d.en: The grayscale input image is convolved with 6 kernels of size 5×5, extracting 6 kinds of low-level geometric features.

ea3ab60a3b7f.zh: 2×2 下取樣，解析度砍半，通道數維持 6，壓縮空間冗餘。
ea3ab60a3b7f.en: 2×2 downsampling halves the resolution, keeps 6 channels, and compresses spatial redundancy.

fd76ee9426f8.zh: 5×5 核進一步抽取組合特徵，通道數擴張至 16。
fd76ee9426f8.en: 5×5 kernels extract combined features further, expanding the channels to 16.

50c05283fbf6.zh: 再次下取樣，得到緊湊的 5×5×16 特徵張量。
50c05283fbf6.en: Downsampling again gives a compact 5×5×16 feature tensor.

fa4d9d9546bf.zh: 拉平成向量後，依序透過 120、84，最後 10 維輸出對應數字 0–9。
fa4d9d9546bf.en: After flattening into a vector, it passes through 120, then 84, and finally a 10-dimensional output for the digits 0–9.

3d0fc2f5fc00.en: Spatial structure kept · resolution halves, channels multiply

3e37336fd42c.zh: 空間已抽完 · 專注高階語意分類
3e37336fd42c.en: Space fully extracted · focus on high-level semantic classification

4749d74195d5.zh: 黃金準則：若一開始就 Flatten，後面再多層 FC 也救不回被丟棄的空間結構
4749d74195d5.en: Golden rule: flatten at the start, and no number of FC layers afterwards can recover the discarded spatial structure

8fae7ac6cc60.zh: LeNet 的結構順序就是最強先驗：先局部滑動抽取圖案，最後才做全圖決策。
8fae7ac6cc60.en: LeNet's layer order is its strongest prior: first slide locally to extract patterns, and only at the end make the whole-image decision.

e622ea69d82a.zh: 圖解 LeNet-5：空間特徵抽取 $\to$ 向量分類決策的標準二段式
e622ea69d82a.en: LeNet-5 illustrated: the standard two-part design of spatial feature extraction $\to$ vector classification decision

482e0b1f2b83.en: 📐 The order of the structure is the "prior"

f1a4fb4e1ccf.zh: 這張圖揭示了 CNN 架構設計的核心哲學：
f1a4fb4e1ccf.en: This diagram reveals the core philosophy of CNN architecture design:

b75a1a6e7f39.zh: 左側 Conv/Pool：神經元僅具備局部感受野，權重在整個平面共享，專注提取邊緣、轉角等基礎形狀。
b75a1a6e7f39.en: Conv/Pool on the left: neurons have only local receptive fields, their weights are shared across the whole plane, and they focus on extracting basic shapes such as edges and corners.

fe693e57032e.zh: 右側 FC：到了最後階段，空間圖案已轉化為高度抽象的特徵組合，此時才將空間攤平，交由全連線層權衡全域性權重。
fe693e57032e.en: FC on the right: by the last stage, the spatial patterns have been turned into highly abstract feature combinations; only then is the space flattened and handed to the fully connected layers to weigh global weights.

f3cbb49c0445.zh: 為什麼後世二十年的 CNN 還在延續這張骨架？ Why Modern CNNs Still Follow the LeNet Blueprint
f3cbb49c0445.en: Why Do Twenty Years of Later CNNs Still Keep This Skeleton?

05341727b70e.zh: 淺層卷積捕捉方向、邊緣與紋理；深層卷積將小局部拼接為零件（如眼睛、輪子）；最後全連線層判斷整體物件。這符合生物視覺與自然影象的階層組合本質。
05341727b70e.en: Shallow convolutions capture orientations, edges and textures; deeper convolutions assemble small local pieces into parts (such as eyes or wheels); finally the fully connected layers judge the whole object. This matches the hierarchical, compositional nature of biological vision and natural images.

da769acdb7b8.zh: ⚡ 算力與參數量最佳分配
da769acdb7b8.en: ⚡ The best allocation of compute and parameters

2610d3c434b8.zh: 高解析度時用參數極少的卷積核運算（節省權重）；當特徵圖縮小到很低解析度時，才使用全連線層，避免了全圖全連線帶來的參數爆炸。
2610d3c434b8.en: At high resolution, use convolution kernels with very few parameters (saving weights); only when the feature map has shrunk to a very low resolution are fully connected layers used, avoiding the parameter explosion that whole-image full connectivity would bring.

8b7a2feba39e.zh: 2012 年奪下 ImageNet 冠軍的 AlexNet，本質上就是 GPU 加速版、更深更寬的 LeNet：同樣是多層 Conv/Pool 串接，最後接 FC 4096-4096-1000。
8b7a2feba39e.en: AlexNet, which won ImageNet in 2012, is essentially a GPU-accelerated, deeper and wider LeNet: the same stack of multiple Conv/Pool layers, followed at the end by FC 4096-4096-1000.

1fbf6d9458f8.zh: VGG 更是將「卷積 $\to$ 池化減半」的迴圈模組化，把骨架規格化為純粹的 3×3 核堆疊，但總體「先抽特徵、再決策」的邏輯依然源於 LeNet。
1fbf6d9458f8.en: VGG goes further and modularizes the "convolution $\to$ pooling halves the size" loop, standardizing the skeleton into pure stacks of 3×3 kernels, but the overall logic of "extract features first, then decide" still comes from LeNet.

001903fb2466.zh:
🧪 實測大觀察：
1. 參數量集中地：觀察 Readout 中的參數量統計——前四層 Conv/Pool 總共只有約 3,000 個參數，而後三層 FC 就佔了 57,000+ 參數（>90%）！這正是為什麼現代 CNN（如 ResNet）會用 Global Average Pooling 取代肥大的全連線層。
2. 特徵圖演變：解析度從 28×28 逐步腰斬至 5×5，而語意通道數由 1 升至 16，完成特徵抽象化。
001903fb2466.en:
🧪 The big hands-on observation:
1. Where the parameters concentrate: look at the parameter counts in the Readout: the first four Conv/Pool layers have only about 3,000 parameters in total, while the last three FC layers take up 57,000+ (>90%)! This is exactly why modern CNNs (such as ResNet) replace the bloated fully connected layers with global average pooling.
2. How the feature maps evolve: the resolution is cut down step by step from 28×28 to 5×5, while the number of semantic channels rises from 1 to 16, completing the abstraction of features.
